method: Wash and dry the lettuce and tomato. Shred the lettuce and slice the tomato; put both on a clean plate, separate from the raw filling.
Split the wholemeal burger bun and toast the cut faces in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1–2 minutes. Set it on a clean plate.

Check the salmon fillet for pin bones and pat it dry. Keep it as a fillet for cooking. Coat with all the measured paprika, chilli powder, garlic powder and dried oregano. After handling raw salmon fillet, wash hands and clean the board, knife and work surface before touching the ready-to-eat ingredients.

Heat the measured olive oil in the non-stick frying pan. Cook the salmon over a medium heat for about 4–5 minutes on the first side and 3–4 minutes on the other; start skin-side down if it has skin. Turn with a wide spatula. Check the thickest part: the fish should be opaque through the centre and separate readily into flakes. Keep cooking if the centre is translucent.
Put the lettuce and tomato in the toasted bun, add the cooked salmon fillet, then close the bun and serve immediately.
